description.en:
📦 Deliver first, land later!

Charge a fart boost, launch across the toy town of Fartville and drop parcels in the right mailbox. Solo or with up to 50 couriers.

• Hold the boost button to charge, let go to launch. The harder you blast, the farther you fly… but the landing is up to you.
• Six parcel types: regular, floaty balloon, fragile cake, runaway box, sticky slime and a chilled parcel that has to arrive before it melts.
• Take rooftop shortcuts, go for mailbox trick shots and rooftop drops for achievements.
• Dropped it? No problem. Free return to the post office.

Paid fart effects only change shape and colour; speed, gas and rewards stay the same for everyone.
